standard.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 5.0.0
standard.description: A curated five-requirement Level 1 source and documentation pilot. It is not the complete ASVS denominator and does not provide certification.

license.attribution: OWASP Foundation, OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 5.0.0. Selected requirement identifiers and statements are reproduced under CC BY-SA 4.0; Contractor mapping objectives are independently authored adaptations.

entries.title: Parameterized database queries
entries.statement: Verify that data selection or database queries (e.g., SQL, HQL, NoSQL, Cypher) use parameterized queries, ORMs, entity frameworks, or are otherwise protected from SQL Injection and other database injection attacks. This is also relevant when writing stored procedures.

entries.title: OS command injection prevention
entries.statement: Verify that the application protects against OS command injection and that operating system calls use parameterized OS queries or use contextual command line output encoding.

entries.title: Dynamic code execution
entries.statement: Verify that the application avoids the use of eval() or other dynamic code execution features such as Spring Expression Language (SpEL). Where there is no alternative, any user input being included must be sanitized before being executed.

entries.title: Restrictive XML parsing
entries.statement: Verify that the application configures XML parsers to use a restrictive configuration and that unsafe features such as resolving external entities are disabled to prevent XML eXternal Entity (XXE) attacks.

entries.title: Documented input validation rules
entries.statement: Verify that the application's documentation defines input validation rules for how to check the validity of data items against an expected structure. This could be common data formats such as credit card numbers, email addresses, telephone numbers, or it could be an internal data format.

mappings.title: Trace database query construction
mappings.objective: Trace representative untrusted inputs to application-owned database query construction and verify effective parameterization or an equivalent injection control. Record every unresolved query surface as a gap.

mappings.title: Trace operating-system command construction
mappings.objective: Trace representative untrusted inputs to application-owned process execution and verify parameter separation or suitable contextual encoding. Record uninspected command paths as gaps.

mappings.title: Review dynamic execution paths
mappings.objective: Inspect application-owned dynamic code or expression execution paths and verify that they are absent or that any included untrusted input has an effective sanitizer. Preserve ambiguous flows as gaps.

mappings.title: Review XML parser configuration
mappings.objective: Inspect application-owned XML parser creation and configuration for restrictive defaults and explicit disabling of unsafe external entity behavior. Record parser paths that cannot be resolved as gaps.

mappings.title: Review documented validation rules
mappings.objective: Inspect supplied application documentation for explicit input-validation rules and expected data structures. The owner must first decide whether this documentary requirement applies to the supplied scope.
